item.title: Lionsgate Quarterly Home Entertainment Revenue Rises on Theatrical Releases ‘The Long Walk,’ ‘Good Fortune’
item.description: Lionsgate Feb. 5 reported third-quarter (ended Dec 31, 2025) motion picture home entertainment revenue of $169 million, up nearly 5% from revenue of $161.7 million in the previous-year period. Digital movie revenue increased 6.5% to $155.1 million from $145.7 million. Packaged media revenue declined 12% to $14.1 million from $16 million.
